title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Carroll College
description: Discover the essential late-night food and study destinations for Carroll College students in Helena, from on-campus dining rituals to local 24-hour diners.

cards.title: Late Night at the STAC
cards.subtitle: Campus Dining Center
cards.notes: Visit the STAC for late-night dining options like pizza and burgers available until 11:00 PM daily during the academic semester.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus dining hall offering extended evening hours for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The St. Thomas Aquinas Commons (STAC) offers late-night dining options including Pizza, Twists, Sizzle, Simple, and UCook from 8:00 PM to 11:00 PM daily.
cards.source_title: Hours of Operation | Carroll College Dining
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM for late-night food service.

cards.title: The 24-Hour Diner Tradition
cards.subtitle: Classic American Diner
cards.notes: Head to this local staple for breakfast food or burgers at any hour; it is a classic destination for late-night study breaks.
cards.short_summary: A locally owned 24-hour diner serving breakfast and comfort food all day and night.
cards.evidence_claim: Shellie's Country Cafe is open 24 hours per day, 7 days per week, serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
cards.source_title: Shellie's Country Cafe | Family Style Restaurant | Helena, MT

cards.title: Evening Coffee at Holy Grounds
cards.subtitle: On-Campus Coffee Shop
cards.notes: Grab a specialty coffee or snack at this campus hub, which stays open until 9:00 PM on weekdays for evening study sessions.
cards.short_summary: The central campus coffee shop located in the Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Holy Grounds is open Monday through Friday from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Hours of Operation | Carroll College Dining

cards.title: Late-Night Taco Runs
cards.subtitle: Fast Food on Vandelay Ave
cards.notes: Drive over to Vandelay Avenue for a late-night meal; the drive-thru remains open until 3:00 AM for late-night cravings.
cards.short_summary: A popular fast-food destination for students seeking late-night options off-campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell location at 1485 Vandelay Ave in Helena is open until 3:00 AM.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell® in Helena, MT - 1485 Vandelay Ave

cards.title: Midnight Grocery Trips
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Supermarket
cards.notes: Stock up on dorm snacks or bulk items at any hour; this employee-owned store is a go-to for 24-hour shopping in Helena.
cards.short_summary: A large 24-hour grocery store providing affordable food options at all hours.
cards.evidence_claim: WinCo Foods in Helena is open 24 hours a day.

cards.title: The Town Pump Pit Stop
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Convenience Store
cards.notes: Stop by for quick snacks, hot deli items, or beverages; these Montana-owned stations are open 24/7 throughout Helena.
cards.short_summary: A ubiquitous Montana convenience store chain offering 24-hour service and snacks.
cards.evidence_claim: Town Pump convenience stores are open 24 hours and offer hot deli items and snacks.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours for snacks and fuel.

cards.entity_name: Corette Library and Simperman Learning Commons
cards.title: Late-Night Study Sessions
cards.subtitle: Academic Resource Center
cards.notes: Utilize the collaborative and individual study spaces; check the seasonal schedule for extended hours during finals week.
cards.short_summary: The primary library on campus offering various technology-equipped study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Corette Library and Simperman Learning Commons provide spaces for individual and group study.
cards.access_notes: Standard hours vary; typically open until midnight during peak academic periods.

cards.title: Late-Night Golden Arches
cards.subtitle: Fast Food on Prospect Ave
cards.notes: Visit for a quick late-night meal; the Prospect Avenue location serves the campus community until 11:00 PM daily.
cards.short_summary: A familiar fast-food option for students looking for a quick bite before midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: The McDonald's at 1901 Prospect Ave in Helena is open daily from 5:30 AM to 11:00 PM.

cards.title: Socializing in 'Charlies'
cards.subtitle: Residence Hall Common Area
cards.notes: Gather in the large lounge area of the campus's oldest building for late-night socializing, featuring booths and a big-screen TV.
cards.short_summary: A historic residence hall lounge that serves as a central social hub for students.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Charles Hall features a huge lounge area with couches, chairs, booths, and a big-screen TV for student socializing.
cards.access_notes: Accessible to residents and their guests 24/7.

cards.title: Finals Week Late Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Semester Tradition at the STAC
cards.notes: Join faculty and staff for a free late-night breakfast served during finals week to support students during their studies.
cards.short_summary: A recurring campus event where faculty serve breakfast to students late at night during finals.
cards.evidence_claim: Carroll College hosts a Late Night Breakfast from 9:00 PM to 11:00 PM at the STAC during finals week.
cards.access_notes: Occurs seasonally during finals week from 9:00 PM to 11:00 PM.
